section_title: Introduction to Trigonometry: The Study of Triangles
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-13.3s) - Introduction to trigonometry
title = Text("Introduction to Trigonometry", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("The Study of Triangles", font_size=36).next_to(title, DOWN)

triangle = Polygon([-2, -1, 0], [2, -1, 0], [0, 2, 0], color=WHITE)
triangle.move_to(ORIGIN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(triangle), run_time=2)
self.wait(7.3)

# Segment 2 (13.3-21.4s) - Focus on right triangles
right_triangle = Polygon([-2, -1, 0], [1, -1, 0], [-2, 2, 0], color=BLUE)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.4, color=BLUE)
right_angle.next_to([-2, -1, 0], UR, buff=0)

self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(triangle, right_triangle),
    Create(right_angle),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(5.1)

# Segment 3 (21.4-28.4s) - Applications
engineering = Text("Engineering", font_size=32).to_edge(LEFT)
astronomy = Text("Astronomy", font_size=32).to_edge(RIGHT)
architecture = Text("Architecture", font_size=32).to_edge(UP + RIGHT)

self.play(
    Write(engineering),
    Write(astronomy), 
    Write(architecture),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(4)

# Segment 4 (28.4-35.8s) - Key components
self.play(
    FadeOut(engineering),
    FadeOut(astronomy),
    FadeOut(architecture),
    run_time=1
)

components_text = Text("Key Components", font_size=36)
components_text.next_to(subtitle, DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(Write(components_text), run_time=2)
self.wait(4.4)

# Segment 5 (35.8-49.3s) - Identifying sides
hyp_label = Text("Hypotenuse", font_size=24, color=YELLOW)
opp_label = Text("Opposite", font_size=24, color=GREEN)
adj_label = Text("Adjacent", font_size=24, color=RED)

hyp_line = Line([-2, 2, 0], [1, -1, 0], color=YELLOW)
opp_line = Line([-2, 2, 0], [-2, -1, 0], color=GREEN)
adj_line = Line([-2, -1, 0], [1, -1, 0], color=RED)

hyp_label.next_to(hyp_line, UR)
opp_label.next_to(opp_line, LEFT)
adj_label.next_to(adj_line, DOWN)

self.play(
    Transform(right_triangle.copy(), hyp_line),
    Write(hyp_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Transform(right_triangle.copy(), opp_line),
    Write(opp_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Transform(right_triangle.copy(), adj_line),
    Write(adj_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(7.6)

# Segment 6 (49.3-56.8s) - Side labels change
angle_theta = Arc(radius=0.5, angle=PI/3, color=WHITE)
angle_theta.shift(LEFT * 2 + DOWN)
theta_label = MathTex(r"\theta", color=WHITE)
theta_label.next_to(angle_theta, RIGHT, buff=0.1)

self.play(
    Create(angle_theta),
    Write(theta_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(5.5)

# Segment 7 (56.8-69.9s) - Foundation for trig ratios
final_text = Text("Foundation for\nTrigonometric Ratios", font_size=36)
final_text.next_to(right_triangle, RIGHT, buff=1)

self.play(Write(final_text), run_time=3)
self.wait(10.1)

section_title: The Six Trigonometric Ratios: Sine, Cosine, Tangent and Their Reciprocals
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0.0s - 12.3s) - Introduction to trig ratios
title = Text("The Six Trigonometric Ratios", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
triangle = Polygon(
    ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, UP*2, 
    color=WHITE
).shift(DOWN)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.3, color=WHITE).move_to(
    triangle.get_vertices()[0]
).shift(RIGHT*0.15 + UP*0.15)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(triangle), Create(right_angle), run_time=2)
self.wait(8.3)

# Segment 2 (12.3s - 20.9s) - Importance of identifying sides
angle = Arc(
    radius=0.5,
    angle=np.arctan(2/3),
    color=YELLOW
).move_to(triangle.get_vertices()[0]).shift(RIGHT*0.5)
theta = MathTex(r"\theta").next_to(angle, RIGHT, buff=0.1)

self.play(
    Create(angle),
    Write(theta),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(6.6)

# Segment 3 (20.9s - 26.8s) - Defining hypotenuse
hyp = Line(
    triangle.get_vertices()[1],
    triangle.get_vertices()[2],
    color=RED
)
hyp_label = Text("Hypotenuse", font_size=24, color=RED).next_to(hyp, RIGHT)

self.play(
    Create(hyp),
    Write(hyp_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(3.8)

# Segment 4 (26.8s - 38.6s) - Opposite and adjacent sides
opp = Line(triangle.get_vertices()[0], triangle.get_vertices()[2], color=BLUE)
adj = Line(triangle.get_vertices()[0], triangle.get_vertices()[1], color=GREEN)
opp_label = Text("Opposite", font_size=24, color=BLUE).next_to(opp, LEFT)
adj_label = Text("Adjacent", font_size=24, color=GREEN).next_to(adj, DOWN)

self.play(
    Create(opp),
    Create(adj),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Write(opp_label),
    Write(adj_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(7.8)

# Segment 5 (38.6s - 44.4s) - Primary ratios intro
primary = Text("Primary Ratios:", font_size=32).shift(UP*2 + LEFT*4)
self.play(Write(primary), run_time=2)
self.wait(3.8)

# Segment 6 (44.4s - 50.7s) - Sine ratio
sine = MathTex(r"\sin \theta = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}", color=YELLOW).next_to(primary, DOWN)
self.play(Write(sine), run_time=2)
self.wait(4.3)

# Segment 7 (50.7s - 56.6s) - Cosine ratio
cosine = MathTex(r"\cos \theta = \frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}}", color=YELLOW).next_to(sine, DOWN)
self.play(Write(cosine), run_time=2)
self.wait(3.9)

# Segment 8 (56.6s - 62.8s) - Tangent ratio
tangent = MathTex(r"\tan \theta = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}", color=YELLOW).next_to(cosine, DOWN)
self.play(Write(tangent), run_time=2)
self.wait(4.2)

# Segment 9 (62.8s - 71.8s) - Reciprocal ratios intro
reciprocal = Text("Reciprocal Ratios:", font_size=32).shift(UP*2 + RIGHT*4)
self.play(Write(reciprocal), run_time=2)
self.wait(7)

# Segment 10 (71.8s - 77.7s) - Cosecant ratio
cosec = MathTex(r"\csc \theta = \frac{\text{hypotenuse}}{\text{opposite}}", color=ORANGE).next_to(reciprocal, DOWN)
self.play(Write(cosec), run_time=2)
self.wait(3.9)

# Segment 11 (77.7s - 83.6s) - Secant ratio
sec = MathTex(r"\sec \theta = \frac{\text{hypotenuse}}{\text{adjacent}}", color=ORANGE).next_to(cosec, DOWN)
self.play(Write(sec), run_time=2)
self.wait(3.9)

# Segment 12 (83.6s - 90.6s) - Cotangent ratio
cot = MathTex(r"\cot \theta = \frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{opposite}}", color=ORANGE).next_to(sec, DOWN)
self.play(Write(cot), run_time=2)
self.wait(5.1)

# Segment 13 (90.6s - 99.3s) - Summary
final_box = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(primary, sine, cosine, tangent, reciprocal, cosec, sec, cot))
self.play(Create(final_box), run_time=2)
self.wait(6.7)

section_title: Example: Calculating All Ratios from a Given Tangent
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-14.2s) - Introduction
title = Text("Finding All Trig Ratios from Tangent", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
problem = MathTex(r"\tan A = \frac{4}{3}", font_size=48).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=1)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(problem), run_time=2)
self.wait(10.2)

# Segment 2 (14.2-25.8s) - Right triangle setup
triangle = Polygon(
    ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, UP*4,
    color=WHITE,
    fill_opacity=0.2
)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.3).next_to(ORIGIN, UR, buff=0)
angle_A = Arc(radius=0.5, angle=math.atan(4/3), color=YELLOW)
angle_label = MathTex("A").next_to(angle_A, RIGHT, buff=0.1)

self.play(
    Create(triangle),
    Create(right_angle),
    Create(angle_A),
    Write(angle_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(8.5)

# Segment 3 (25.8-34.5s) - Labeling sides
opp_label = MathTex("4").next_to(triangle, RIGHT)
adj_label = MathTex("3").next_to(triangle, DOWN)
opp_brace = Brace(Line(ORIGIN, UP*4), RIGHT)
adj_brace = Brace(Line(ORIGIN, RIGHT*3), DOWN)

self.play(
    Create(opp_brace), Write(opp_label),
    Create(adj_brace), Write(adj_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(5.8)

# Segment 4 (34.5-49.1s) - Pythagorean theorem
pythag = MathTex(r"c^2 = a^2 + b^2").shift(RIGHT*4)
self.play(Write(pythag), run_time=2)
self.wait(12.6)

# Segment 5 (49.1-65.5s) - Calculate hypotenuse
calc1 = MathTex(r"c^2 = 4^2 + 3^2").next_to(pythag, DOWN)
calc2 = MathTex(r"c^2 = 16 + 9 = 25").next_to(calc1, DOWN)
calc3 = MathTex(r"c = 5").next_to(calc2, DOWN)
hyp_label = MathTex("5").next_to(triangle, UR)
hyp_brace = Brace(Line(RIGHT*3, UP*4), UL)

self.play(Write(calc1), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(calc2), run_time=2)
self.play(
    Write(calc3),
    Create(hyp_brace),
    Write(hyp_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(10.4)

# Segment 6 (65.5-77.1s) - Sine calculation
sine_def = MathTex(r"\sin A = \frac{opp}{hyp} = \frac{4}{5}").shift(LEFT*4 + UP*2)
self.play(
    Write(sine_def),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(8.6)

# Segment 7 (77.1-87.1s) - Cosine and cosecant
cos_def = MathTex(r"\cos A = \frac{adj}{hyp} = \frac{3}{5}").next_to(sine_def, DOWN)
csc_def = MathTex(r"\csc A = \frac{5}{4}").next_to(cos_def, DOWN)
self.play(
    Write(cos_def),
    Write(csc_def),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(6.9)

# Segment 8 (87.1-104.9s) - Secant, cotangent and summary
sec_def = MathTex(r"\sec A = \frac{5}{3}").next_to(csc_def, DOWN)
cot_def = MathTex(r"\cot A = \frac{3}{4}").next_to(sec_def, DOWN)
box = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(sine_def, cos_def, csc_def, sec_def, cot_def))

self.play(
    Write(sec_def),
    Write(cot_def),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Create(box), run_time=2)
self.wait(12.8)

section_title: Example: Proving Angle Equality from Sine Ratios
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-14.7s) - Introduction
title = Text("Proving Angle Equality from Sine Ratios", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
initial_equation = MathTex(r"\sin B = \sin Q \implies B = Q").next_to(title, DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(initial_equation), run_time=2)
self.wait(10.7)

# Segment 2 (14.7-27.3s) - Display triangles
triangle_ABC = Polygon(
    [0, 0, 0], [3, 0, 0], [3, 2, 0],
    color=BLUE
).shift(LEFT * 3)
triangle_PQR = Polygon(
    [0, 0, 0], [2, 0, 0], [2, 1.5, 0],
    color=RED
).shift(RIGHT * 3)

labels_ABC = VGroup(
    MathTex("A").next_to(triangle_ABC.get_vertices()[0], DOWN),
    MathTex("B").next_to(triangle_ABC.get_vertices()[1], DOWN),
    MathTex("C").next_to(triangle_ABC.get_vertices()[2], UP)
)
labels_PQR = VGroup(
    MathTex("P").next_to(triangle_PQR.get_vertices()[0], DOWN),
    MathTex("Q").next_to(triangle_PQR.get_vertices()[1], DOWN),
    MathTex("R").next_to(triangle_PQR.get_vertices()[2], UP)
)

self.play(
    Create(triangle_ABC),
    Create(triangle_PQR),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(
    Write(labels_ABC),
    Write(labels_PQR),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(7.6)

# Segment 3 (27.3-38.2s) - Show initial condition
right_angle_ABC = RightAngle(triangle_ABC.get_vertices()[0], triangle_ABC.get_vertices()[1], triangle_ABC.get_vertices()[2])
right_angle_PQR = RightAngle(triangle_PQR.get_vertices()[0], triangle_PQR.get_vertices()[1], triangle_PQR.get_vertices()[2])
condition = MathTex(r"\sin B = \sin Q").next_to(initial_equation, DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(
    Create(right_angle_ABC),
    Create(right_angle_PQR),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(condition), run_time=2)
self.wait(6.9)

# Segment 4 (38.2-46.4s) - Sine ratio definition
sine_def = MathTex(r"\sin \theta = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}").next_to(condition, DOWN, buff=0.5)
self.play(Write(sine_def), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.2)

# Segment 5 (46.4-61.7s) - Show ratios
ratio_equation = MathTex(
    r"\frac{AC}{AB} = \frac{PR}{PQ}"
).next_to(sine_def, DOWN, buff=0.5)
rearranged = MathTex(
    r"\frac{AC}{PR} = \frac{AB}{PQ}"
).next_to(ratio_equation, DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(Write(ratio_equation), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(rearranged), run_time=3)
self.wait(9.3)

# Segment 6 (61.7-70.4s) - Common ratio k
k_def = MathTex(
    r"\frac{AC}{PR} = \frac{AB}{PQ} = k"
).next_to(rearranged, DOWN, buff=0.5)
self.play(Write(k_def), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.7)

# Segment 7 (70.4-82.3s) - Pythagorean theorem
pythag_ABC = MathTex(r"BC^2 = AB^2 - AC^2").shift(LEFT * 3, DOWN * 2)
pythag_PQR = MathTex(r"QR^2 = PQ^2 - PR^2").shift(RIGHT * 3, DOWN * 2)

self.play(
    Write(pythag_ABC),
    Write(pythag_PQR),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(9)

# Segment 8 (82.3-95.1s) - Substitute k
k_substitution = MathTex(
    r"\frac{BC}{QR} = k"
).next_to(k_def, DOWN, buff=0.5)
self.play(Write(k_substitution), run_time=3)
self.wait(9.7)

# Segment 9 (95.1-104.6s) - Similar triangles
similar_triangles = Text("△ABC ~ △PQR", font_size=36).next_to(k_substitution, DOWN, buff=0.5)
self.play(Write(similar_triangles), run_time=2)
self.wait(7.5)

# Segment 10 (104.6-113.3s) - Angle equality
final_conclusion = MathTex(r"B = Q").next_to(similar_triangles, DOWN, buff=0.5)
self.play(Write(final_conclusion), run_time=2)
self.wait(6.7)

# Segment 11 (113.3-130.1s) - Summary
summary_box = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(
    title, initial_equation, condition, final_conclusion
))
self.play(Create(summary_box), run_time=3)
self.wait(13.8)

# Segment 1 (0.0-8.9s) - Introduction
title = Text("Verifying Trigonometric Identities", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Using the Pythagorean Theorem", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=3)
self.wait(2.9)

# Segment 2 (8.9-18.4s) - Pythagorean Identity
identity = MathTex(r"\cos^2 \theta + \sin^2 \theta = 1").scale(1.5)
self.play(Write(identity), run_time=3)
self.play(Indicate(identity, color=YELLOW), run_time=3)
self.wait(3.6)

# Segment 3 (18.4-27.7s) - Right Triangle
self.play(FadeOut(subtitle), identity.animate.to_edge(UP), run_time=2)

# Create right triangle
triangle = Polygon(
    ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, UP*2, 
    color=WHITE,
    fill_opacity=0.2
)
labels = VGroup(
    MathTex("adj").next_to(triangle, DOWN),
    MathTex("opp").next_to(triangle, RIGHT),
    MathTex("hyp").next_to(triangle.get_center(), UP+LEFT),
    MathTex(r"\theta").next_to(triangle.get_vertices()[0], RIGHT/2)
)
self.play(Create(triangle), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(labels), run_time=2)
self.wait(2.2)

# Segment 4 (27.7-37.3s) - Cosine and Sine Ratios
ratios = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\cos \theta = \frac{adj}{hyp}"),
    MathTex(r"\sin \theta = \frac{opp}{hyp}")
).arrange(DOWN).next_to(triangle, RIGHT, buff=1)
self.play(Write(ratios[0]), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(ratios[1]), run_time=3)
self.wait(3.6)

# Segment 5 (37.3-47.6s) - Squaring Ratios
squared_ratios = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\cos^2 \theta = \frac{adj^2}{hyp^2}"),
    MathTex(r"\sin^2 \theta = \frac{opp^2}{hyp^2}")
).arrange(DOWN).next_to(ratios, RIGHT, buff=1)
self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(ratios[0].copy(), squared_ratios[0]),
    ReplacementTransform(ratios[1].copy(), squared_ratios[1]),
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(6.4)

# Segment 6 (47.6-55.5s) - Combining Fractions
combined = MathTex(r"\frac{adj^2 + opp^2}{hyp^2}").next_to(triangle, DOWN, buff=2)
self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(squared_ratios, combined),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(4.9)

# Segment 7 (55.5-66.4s) - Pythagorean Theorem
pyth_theorem = MathTex(r"adj^2 + opp^2 = hyp^2").next_to(combined, DOWN)
self.play(Write(pyth_theorem), run_time=3)
self.play(Indicate(pyth_theorem, color=YELLOW), run_time=3)
self.wait(4.9)

# Segment 8 (66.4-72.5s) - Substitution
substituted = MathTex(r"\frac{hyp^2}{hyp^2}").next_to(pyth_theorem, DOWN)
self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(combined.copy(), substituted),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(3.1)

# Segment 9 (72.5-82.7s) - Simplification
final_one = MathTex("1").next_to(substituted, RIGHT)
self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(substituted, final_one),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(7.1)

# Segment 10 (82.7-89.4s) - Verification Complete
box = SurroundingRectangle(identity, color=GREEN)
self.play(Create(box), run_time=2)
self.wait(4.7)

# Segment 11 (89.4-94.3s) - Universal Statement
universal = Text("Valid for all angles θ", font_size=32).next_to(box, DOWN)
self.play(Write(universal), run_time=2)
self.wait(2.9)

# Segment 12 (94.3-104.8s) - Other Identities
other_identities = Text("Other identities can be verified similarly", font_size=32).next_to(universal, DOWN)
self.play(Write(other_identities), run_time=3)
self.wait(7.5)

# Segment 13 (104.8-109.9s) - Conclusion
self.play(
    FadeOut(VGroup(triangle, labels, ratios, pyth_theorem, substituted, final_one, universal, other_identities)),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Indicate(identity, color=GREEN), run_time=2)
self.wait(1.1)

section_title: Example: Finding Sides and Ratios from a Given Relationship
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0.0s - 12.5s) - Introduction
title = Text("Trigonometric Ratios Example", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
problem = MathTex(r"\sin B = \sin Q").scale(1.5)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(problem), run_time=2)
self.wait(8.5)

# Segment 2 (12.5s - 20.2s) - Goal statement
goal = Text("Goal: Prove angle B = angle Q", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)
self.play(Write(goal), run_time=2)
self.wait(5.7)

# Segment 3 (20.2s - 30.3s) - Drawing triangles
# Triangle ABC
triangle_abc = Polygon(
    [-3, -1, 0], [-3, 1, 0], [-1, -1, 0],
    color=BLUE
)
abc_labels = VGroup(
    Text("A", font_size=24).next_to(triangle_abc.get_vertices()[0], LEFT),
    Text("B", font_size=24).next_to(triangle_abc.get_vertices()[1], LEFT),
    Text("C", font_size=24).next_to(triangle_abc.get_vertices()[2], RIGHT)
)
right_angle_abc = Square(side_length=0.2).move_to(triangle_abc.get_vertices()[2])

# Triangle PQR
triangle_pqr = Polygon(
    [1, -1, 0], [1, 1, 0], [3, -1, 0],
    color=RED
)
pqr_labels = VGroup(
    Text("P", font_size=24).next_to(triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[0], LEFT),
    Text("Q", font_size=24).next_to(triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[1], LEFT),
    Text("R", font_size=24).next_to(triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[2], RIGHT)
)
right_angle_pqr = Square(side_length=0.2).move_to(triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[2])

self.play(
    Create(triangle_abc), Create(triangle_pqr),
    Create(right_angle_abc), Create(right_angle_pqr),
    Write(abc_labels), Write(pqr_labels),
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(6.1)

# Segment 4 (30.3s - 40.4s) - Sine ratio for ABC
sine_b = MathTex(r"\sin B = \frac{AC}{AB}").next_to(triangle_abc, DOWN)
highlight_ac = Line(
    triangle_abc.get_vertices()[0],
    triangle_abc.get_vertices()[2],
    color=YELLOW
)
highlight_ab = Line(
    triangle_abc.get_vertices()[0],
    triangle_abc.get_vertices()[1],
    color=GREEN
)
self.play(Write(sine_b), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(highlight_ac), Create(highlight_ab), run_time=2)
self.wait(6.1)

# Segment 5 (40.4s - 53.6s) - Sine ratio for PQR and equality
sine_q = MathTex(r"\sin Q = \frac{PR}{PQ}").next_to(triangle_pqr, DOWN)
equality = MathTex(r"\frac{AC}{AB} = \frac{PR}{PQ}").next_to(sine_q, DOWN)
highlight_pr = Line(
    triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[0],
    triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[2],
    color=YELLOW
)
highlight_pq = Line(
    triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[0],
    triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[1],
    color=GREEN
)
self.play(Write(sine_q), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(highlight_pr), Create(highlight_pq), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(equality), run_time=2)
